scientific_question: Do context-conditioned RAD-DINO nominal patch distances localize BTXRD tumors, and does a fixed overlapping multiscale view improve the 94 sub-1% tumors relative to the identical single-scale memory arm?
scientific_role: mechanism feasibility probe; not a final pseudo-mask pipeline and not a PatchCore reproduction

allowed_information: binary image-level normal/tumor labels used only to form the normal memory cohort

normal_memory.image_preprocessing: black square pad then bicubic resize
normal_memory.feature_projection: seed-42 frozen Gaussian Johnson-Lindenstrauss 768-to-128, then L2 normalization
normal_memory.context_retrieval: top 8 normal images by cosine similarity of L2-normalized CLS embeddings
normal_memory.patch_distance: one minus maximum cosine similarity within plus/minus 2 patch coordinates in the 8 retrieved normal images
normal_memory.calibration: leave-one-image-out empirical CDF fitted only on train-normal patch distances; separate frozen full-view and pooled-tile calibrations

multiscale.views: same full view plus four fixed 280x280 overlapping corner crops, each resized to 448x448
multiscale.final_fusion: 0.5 full calibrated map plus 0.5 tile canvas

frozen_inference.radiograph_foreground: image-derived foreground only; outside set to zero

diagnostics.comparison: multiscale minus single-scale, paired complete-group bootstrap 10000
diagnostics.promotion_rule: No automatic promotion. A coherent small-lesion gain without material overall, medium or large regression only authorizes a separate predeclared fusion or pseudo-mask experiment.

data_policy.validation_gt: opened only after all 742 arm maps and hashes are frozen
